findings.source: Fanatic: Я натренировался получать ими полезный солнечный свет.
findings.currentTarget: Fanatic: Nimejifunza kupata mwanga wa Jua wenye manufaa kwa hayo.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Fanatic: Nimejifunza kupata mwanga wa Jua wenye manufaa kwa hizo.
findings.objectiveReason: ими refers to the explicitly named kucha/N10 fingernails of the preceding unit; class 6 hayo points to a different noun class.

findings.source: Anger: Я так и вижу, как она на меня смотрит. И разочаровывается.
findings.currentTarget: Anger: Bado ninaona namna alivyokuwa akinitazama. Na kuvunjika moyo.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Anger: Ninawazia wazi jinsi anavyonitazama. Na kuvunjika moyo.
findings.objectiveReason: The deceased grandmother’s disappointed gaze is imagined now (Я так и вижу, как ... смотрит), not a recalled established past event. Alivyokuwa akinitazama invents the past scene as an actual memory.
